title: festuca wagneri var. hungarica
intro: Festuca wagneri var. hungarica, commonly known as Hungarian fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and it is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, and its ability to improve sleep quality and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Festuca wagneri var. hungarica include sedative, antispasmodic, and antiseptic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
